_dataset_notes.purpose: Minimum verified rule set for SIH26034 demo (NiyamDrishti AI). Covers Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended, applicable to RETAIL packages.
_dataset_notes.statute_hierarchy: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (parent Act) -> Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (subordinate legislation, in force from 01-04-2011) -> subsequent Amendment Rules (2017, 2023, 2026).
verified_from: Full consolidated text of the 2011 Rules (Chapters I-VII + Schedules) as hosted by the West Bengal Directorate of Consumer Affairs: https://wbconsumers.gov.in (official state-govt mirror of the DCA notification GSR 202(E) dated 07-03-2011)

Department of Consumer Affairs (nodal ministry) page on the 2017 Amendment: https://consumeraffairs.nic.in/legalmetrology/legal-metrology-packaged-commodities-amendment-rules-2017-vide-nofication-no-gsr-629e
Secondary legal-update summaries (Lexology, TeamLease RegTech, SCC Online) used ONLY to identify amendment dates/sub-rule numbers for 2017, 2023 and 2026 amendments, cross-checked against each other.
important_caveats: requirement_type, severity, and explanation are ENGINEERING classifications made for this system, not terms defined in the statute itself. The statute only prescribes penalties under Rule 32 (flat fines), not a severity scale.

The exact verbatim text of the 2017, 2023, and 2026 Amendment Rules notifications (as published in the e-Gazette) was NOT independently fetched in full for this pass -- only secondary summaries were used for those three amendments. Rule 6(1)(a)-(g), 6(2), 6(3), 7, 9, 18(2) and 26 below ARE verified against the full original 2011 text. Before production use, Member 3 should fetch and verify the actual e-Gazette PDFs for GSR 629(E)/2017, the Oct-2023 notification, and GSR 128(E) & GSR 312(E)/2026 directly from egazette.gov.in.

This is NOT legal advice. Food articles are largely carved out to FSSAI rules (Explanation III to Rule 6(1)(a), proviso to Rule 6(1)(d)); cosmetics defer to Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, 1945 for the mfg-date field. Do not apply these rules blindly to food/cosmetic packages without the sector-specific carve-outs.

Rule 6(10A) as amended in April 2026 (Second Amendment Rules, 2026) is NOT YET IN FORCE -- it commences 01-07-2027 and will supersede the version that commenced 01-07-2026. Both are included below with correct effective windows.

rules.requirement: Every retail package must declare the name and complete address of the manufacturer; where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of both manufacturer and packer; and for imported packages, the name and address of the importer.
rules.explanation: Identifies the legally responsible party for the product; required for consumer redress and enforcement action.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6(1)(a), read with Rule 10(1) and Explanations I & II to Rule 6(1)(a)

rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be declared; if the package contains more than one product, the name and number/quantity of each must be stated.
rules.explanation: Prevents mislabeling and helps consumers identify what they are buying.

rules.requirement: The net quantity of the commodity in the package must be declared in terms of the standard unit of weight/measure, or, where sold by number, the number of items contained.
rules.explanation: Core consumer-protection field; basis for price-per-unit comparison and for maximum-permissible-error checks under the First Schedule.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6(1)(c), read with Rule 11, Rule 12 and the First Schedule

rules.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed, or imported must be declared. Exemptions: bidis, incense sticks, and 14.2kg/5kg domestic LPG cylinders marketed by PSUs are exempt from this field entirely; spare parts/accessories used for warranty servicing (not sold to end customers) are exempt (w.e.f. 01-04-2024); for electronic products, spare parts and accessories, the date must be specified anywhere on the retail package, visibly and legibly (w.e.f. 01-04-2024). Food articles instead follow FSSAI labelling rules.
rules.explanation: Establishes shelf-life/freshness context and supports traceability during inspections.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6(1)(d) and provisos thereto, as amended by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2023 (notified 06-10-2023, this clause effective 01-04-2024)

rules.requirement: The retail sale price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes, must be declared on the package in the form 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs.___ inclusive of all taxes' (or 'MRP Rs.___ incl. of all taxes'), with paise rounding rules applied (below 50 paise rounded down, 50-95 paise rounded to 50 paise). Exceptions: bidis, and domestic LPG cylinders priced under the Administrative Price Mechanism, are exempt from this declaration.
rules.explanation: Prevents overcharging and price ambiguity; the single most enforcement-sensitive field.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 2(m) (definition), Rule 6(1)(e), and Rule 6(1)(g) proviso (C)

rules.requirement: Every package must bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person/office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.
rules.explanation: Enables grievance redress; absence or unclear contact details is a common real-world violation.

rules.requirement: It is not permissible to affix individual stickers to alter or make a required declaration, EXCEPT a sticker reducing the MRP is allowed provided it does not cover the original manufacturer/packer MRP declaration.
rules.explanation: Detects a common tampering pattern -- stickers used to overwrite mandatory fields (MRP, mfg date, address).
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6(3) and its proviso

rules.requirement: Minimum numeral height on the principal display panel scales with declared net quantity: up to 200g/ml -> 1mm (2mm if blown/molded/embossed); 200-500g/ml -> 2mm (4mm); above 500g/ml -> 4mm (6mm). Letter height in any declaration must not be less than 1mm (2mm if blown/molded/embossed), and letter/numeral width not less than one-third of its height (except '1', 'i', 'I', 'l').
rules.explanation: Objective, measurable basis for flagging 'tiny/unreadable text' violations from OCR bounding-box dimensions.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 7(2), 7(3) and Tables I & II thereunder

rules.requirement: All mandatory declarations must be in Hindi (Devanagari script) or in English; other languages may be used in addition to, not instead of, Hindi/English.
rules.explanation: Used to flag packages whose mandatory fields appear only in a regional/foreign language with no Hindi/English equivalent.

rules.requirement: No retail dealer or other person (including manufacturer, packer, importer, wholesale dealer) shall sell a packaged commodity at a price exceeding the declared retail sale price.
rules.explanation: Distinct from label-declaration checks: this is a point-of-sale price-charged-vs-price-declared comparison, relevant if the system is extended to billing data.

rules.requirement: Chapter II declarations (Rules 6-18) do not apply where net weight/measure is 10g/10ml or less; provided that packages of 10g-20g or 10ml-20ml must still declare MRP and net quantity. Also exempt: fast-food packed by restaurants/hotels, certain Drugs (Price Control) Order formulations, and agricultural produce above 50kg.
rules.explanation: Prevents false-positive violations on very small sachets/samples that are lawfully exempt.

rules.requirement: Chapter II (retail package declarations) does NOT apply to: (a) packages containing more than 25kg or 25 litre (except cement/fertilizer sold in bags up to 50kg, which ARE covered); (b) packages meant for industrial or institutional consumers.
rules.explanation: Gate-check before applying any Rule 6 validation -- large/bulk and B2B packages are out of scope for this system's retail-focused checks.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 3(a)-(b) and Explanation thereto

rules.requirement: Every e-commerce entity offering a pre-packaged commodity for sale must display, on the digital/electronic listing, all Rule 6(1) declarations applicable to that commodity EXCEPT the month/year of manufacture or packing.
rules.explanation: Extends label-based checks to online product listings, not just physical packages -- matches the pitch's 'e-commerce' scanning scope.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6(10), inserted by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017 (Notification GSR 629(E) dated 23-06-2017)
rules.verification_note: Rule number and content confirmed via Department of Consumer Affairs advisory page and cross-checked secondary summaries; full e-Gazette text of GSR 629(E) was not independently fetched -- recommend Member 3 verify against egazette.gov.in before relying on this in production.

rules.requirement: Every e-commerce entity offering an imported product for sale must ensure the product listing contains a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.
rules.explanation: Currently-active version of the country-of-origin filter mandate for imported goods sold online.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2026 (Notification GSR 128(E) dated 13-02-2026), inserting Rule 6(10A)
rules.verification_note: Superseded (not repealed) by version 2 below, which takes over on 01-07-2027. Confirm exact wording against egazette.gov.in.

rules.requirement: Every e-commerce entity offering an imported product for sale shall, with effect from 1 July 2027, ensure that the product listing of such imported product contains a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.
rules.explanation: Future/not-yet-active replacement text for the same requirement; keep both rows so the engine can switch versions automatically on the effective date without a redeploy.
rules.source_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second Amendment Rules, 2026 (Notification GSR 312(E) dated 27-04-2026), substituting Rule 6(10A)
